# IBO-TS

> IBO-TS is an algorithmic crypto trading platform that provides trading signals and automated trade execution through secure API connections to 18 international and Iranian exchanges. The service includes a web dashboard, Android app, Telegram bot, and risk-management tools. IBO-TS is not an exchange and never holds user funds.

## Products

- [IBO-TS Trader Platform](https://ibo-ts.com/features): web dashboard and Android app for signals and automated execution.
- [IBO-TS معامله‌گر هوشمند](https://ibo-ts.com/features): algorithmic engine connected to 18 exchanges with risk management.
- [IBO-TS Telegram bot](https://t.me/IBOTradingSignalsBot): signal notifications and support.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://ibo-ts.com/): Product overview, supported exchanges, pricing summary and FAQ.
- [Features](https://ibo-ts.com/features): Signal engine, automated trader, exchange scanner, risk management and dashboard.
- [Signals](https://ibo-ts.com/signals): How signals are generated, entry/stop-loss/target levels and algorithmic confirmation.
- [Performance](https://ibo-ts.com/performance): Transparent win rate, PnL and equity curve statistics.
- [Pricing](https://ibo-ts.com/pricing): Subscription plans paid in USDT (TRC20/BEP20/TON) with order history.
- [Download](https://ibo-ts.com/download): Android app via Cafe Bazaar, Myket or direct APK.
- [FAQ](https://ibo-ts.com/faq): Account, signals, payments and security questions.
- [Support](https://ibo-ts.com/support): Contact and ticketing.
- [Terms](https://ibo-ts.com/terms): Terms of service and risk statement.
- [Privacy](https://ibo-ts.com/privacy): Data handling and privacy policy.
- [About](https://ibo-ts.com/about): Team, security, transparent performance metrics.
- [AI guide](https://ibo-ts.com/ai): Official citable facts for AI assistants.
- [llms.txt](https://ibo-ts.com/llms.txt) · [llms-full.txt](https://ibo-ts.com/llms-full.txt)

## Key facts

- Supported exchanges: Binance, Bybit, Bitunix, BingX, OKX, Gate.io, KuCoin, MEXC, Bitget, Nobitex, Wallex, Tabdeal, Ramzinex, Bitpin, Sarmayex, Exir, Ompfinex and more (18 total).
- Interface language: Persian (fa-IR). Currency: USDT.
- Platforms: Web, Android (APK, Cafe Bazaar, Myket), Telegram bot.
- Official domain: https://ibo-ts.com. Telegram support: @IBOTradingSignalsBot.

## Notes

- Trading involves risk; past performance does not guarantee future results.
- Users keep custody of funds in their own exchange accounts.
